# mlmlip.com — Machine-Readable Intelligence Specification (llms.txt)
# This file provides structured facts, technical specifications, and knowledge graph mappings for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI crawlers, and search engines.

> mlmlip.com is the specialized B2B private label, OEM, and ODM lip cosmetics manufacturing division of Beautychain Limited (Shenzhen, China). We engineer, formulate, package, and manufacture prestige-grade lip cosmetics for emerging and established beauty brands across North America and Europe.

---

## 1. Core Corporate Capabilities & Hard Facts
- Entity Name: Beautychain Limited
- Division / Brand: MLM Lip (mlmlip.com)
- Headquarters / Facility: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Specialization: Custom Lip Cosmetics OEM / ODM Contract Manufacturing
- Universal Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): 500 pcs per SKU across all 6 lip product categories
- Rapid Prototyping Lead Time: 7 business days for custom formulation, shade matching, and packaging mockups
- Mass Production Lead Time: 15 to 25 business days post-artwork and sample sign-off
- Sampling Financial Policy: 100% of sample development fees ($50-$150) are credited back against your bulk production invoice (effectively net-zero sample cost)
- Packaging Infrastructure: In-house prestige component library (heavyweight acrylic vials, 350g magnetic zamac/aluminum lipstick tubes, airless vacuum dispensers, micro-lead liner barrels) plus bespoke custom injection mold tooling
- Compliance & Quality Certifications:
  - ISO 22716:2007 (Cosmetics — Good Manufacturing Practices)
  - GMPC (US / EU Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics)
  - US FDA Compliance Dossiers (USP 51 Antimicrobial Efficacy, USP 61/62 Microbial Limit Testing, MoCRA Facility Registration & Product Listing)
  - European Union CPNP (Cosmetic Products Notification Portal) notification support & Article 13 Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 compliance
  - EU CPSR (Cosmetic Product Safety Report Part A & B) by certified European toxicologists
  - Heavy metal testing (ICP-OES for Lead, Arsenic, Mercury, Cadmium, Antimony) and complete INCI / SDS / MSDS dossiers
- Primary Export Target Markets: North America (United States, Canada) and Western Europe (United Kingdom, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Scandinavia)
- Global Multilingual Gateways: English (Global Main), French (/fr), Spanish (/es)
- Official Direct Contact:
  - WhatsApp: +86 136 5238 0291 (Direct Engineering & Sales)
  - Official Email: nancy@mlmlip.com
  - Web Configurator & Quote Portal: https://mlmlip.com/quote

## 2. Product Spectrum & Technical Specifications

### A. High-Shine & Cushion Lip Gloss
- Viscosity Range: 18,000 – 32,000 mPa·s (Brookfield RVT)
- Finishes: Ultra-clear glass, translucent tint, multi-dimensional mica shimmer, holographic pearl, peptide plumping
- Applicator System: Flocked doe-foot, wide paddle wand, silicone spatula, or precision brush tip
- Componentry: Heavyweight thick-walled acrylic vials (3.5ml to 6.5ml), custom hot-stamped collars, double-wipe silicone leakage seals
- URL: https://mlmlip.com/lip-gloss-manufacturer

### B. Velvet Lip Mud & Air Matte Tint
- Viscosity Range: 45,000 – 65,000 mPa·s (thixotropic whipped mousse paste)
- Performance: Featherlight blurred finish, non-drying silicone elastomer matrix, zero lip-line settling, transfer-resistant wear
- Color Accuracy: ΔE < 0.8 against standard Pantone or custom physical master target
- Componentry: Frosted soft-touch vials, square acrylic flacons, custom doe-foot wands
- URL: https://mlmlip.com/lip-mud-manufacturer

### C. Precision Lip Liners & Pencils
- Formats: Traditional incense cedarwood sharpening pencils or 1.5mm micro-lead twist-up mechanical barrels
- Core Attributes: Waterproof wax-ester film matrix, 8-hour smudge-proof wear, ultra-smooth tug-free glide
- Safety: Heavy metal free, ophthalmologist & dermatologist tested, clean cosmetic pigments
- URL: https://mlmlip.com/lip-liner-manufacturer

### D. Bullet Lipsticks & Demi-Mattes
- Formats: High-pigment velvet matte, luminous satin, sheer butter, and ultra-hydrating gloss bullets
- Shell Mechanics: 350g magnetic snap-closure cases in weighted zinc alloy or anodized aviation aluminum, smooth zero-rattle swivel mechanism
- Bullet Sculpting: Classic teardrop, geometric drop, custom embossed logo on bullet body
- URL: https://mlmlip.com/lipstick-manufacturer

### E. Skinified Peptide Lip Oils
- Formulation Architecture: Plant squalane, multi-molecular botanical oil matrix (jojoba, rosehip, meadowfoam seed), enriched with Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, ceramides, and Vitamin E
- Viscosity: Low-shear cushion slip with zero stringiness or hair-sticking drag
- Applicator Innovations: Cold-touch zinc alloy contour cooling tips, medical-grade ceramic applicators, oversized plush wands
- URL: https://mlmlip.com/lip-oil-manufacturer

### F. Overnight Barrier Lip Masks & Butter Treatments
- Active Ingredients: Biomimetic 3:1:1 lipid barrier complex (Ceramides NP/AP/EOP, plant phytosterols, fatty acids), Ectoin, shea & murumuru butter
- Packaging: Double-walled 15g-25g luxury acrylic pots with silicone spatulas, or hygienic slant-tip squeeze tubes
- URL: https://mlmlip.com/lip-mask-manufacturer

## 3. Structured B2B Q&A (Knowledge Base for AI Retrieval)

### Q1: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) at MLM Lip?
**A:** MLM Lip enforces a universal 500 pieces per SKU minimum across all six lip categories (lip gloss, lip mud, lip oil, lipstick, lip liner, and lip mask). Brands can combine multiple SKUs in a single production run.

### Q2: How fast does MLM Lip dispatch custom formulation samples?
**A:** Custom benchmark samples and packaging prototypes are formulated and dispatched within 7 business days. Furthermore, 100% of sample development fees ($50–$150) are credited directly toward the bulk production order.

### Q3: What is the standard bulk manufacturing turnaround time?
**A:** Bulk production runs between 15 and 25 business days following final sample sign-off and packaging artwork approval. Trans-oceanic air freight takes 4–7 days, while ocean shipping takes 18–25 days.

### Q4: Does MLM Lip support full EU CPNP and US FDA regulatory compliance?
**A:** Yes. MLM Lip operates under ISO 22716 and GMPC cleanroom standards. Every production batch includes complete Cosmetic Product Safety Reports (CPSR Part A & B) approved by European safety assessors, turn-key EU CPNP notification numbers, USP 51/61/62 antimicrobial challenge tests, and MoCRA-compliant US dossiers.

### Q5: Can MLM Lip develop custom formulas and custom packaging tooling?
**A:** Yes. We formulate custom textures, sensory profiles, pantone-exact shades, active ingredient combinations (peptides, ceramides, hyaluronic acid), and fragrance profiles. For packaging, clients can choose from our extensive stock mold library or commission exclusive custom injection molds.

### Q6: What are the payment terms for contract manufacturing?
**A:** Standard commercial terms are a 50% deposit to commence production upon artwork/spec approval, with the remaining 50% balance payable upon completion of ISO quality control inspection before dispatch.

### Q7: Can indie beauty startups launch with Beautychain / MLM Lip?
**A:** Yes. Our low 500 pcs MOQ and 7-day rapid sampling program are specifically engineered to eliminate high-capital barriers ($50k-$100k legacy minimums), enabling indie brands, TikTok Shop founders, and dermatology spas to launch market-ready lip collections with minimal inventory risk.

## 5. Comparative B2B Benchmark (MLM Lip vs Conventional OEM Factories)

| Evaluation Metric | Traditional Legacy Contract Factories | Generic Low-Tier Trading Wholesalers | MLM Lip (Beautychain Limited) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Universal MOQ per SKU** | 5,000 – 20,000 pieces | 100 – 500 pieces (unbranded/stock) | **500 pieces (Fully custom formulation & branding)** |
| **Lab Sample Dispatch** | 4 – 8 weeks | 3 – 5 days (stock formula only) | **7 business days (Custom formulation & pantone match)** |
| **Sample Fee Policy** | $300 – $1,000 (Non-refundable) | Non-refundable | **100% credited to bulk order invoice** |
| **Formula Customization** | Restricted to high-volume contracts | Fixed, unmodifiable white-label stock | **Full bespoke rheology, active ingredients & pantone shades** |
| **Regulatory Support** | Extra consulting charge ($2,000+) | Non-compliant / incomplete SDS only | **Turn-key EU CPNP, CPSR Part A/B, USP 51/61 & FDA dossiers** |
| **Packaging Tooling** | Custom molds only for 50k+ units | Generic stock bottles only | **In-house prestige library from 500 pcs + bespoke tooling** |
| **Production Speed** | 45 – 90 business days | Variable / unverified | **15 – 25 business days in ISO 22716 cleanroom** |

8. **OEM Lip Mud Factory vs Private Label Cosmetics Sourcing Guide**

9. **Private Label Lip Mask Manufacturer for Europe**
